Urea.purpose: High-nitrogen fertilizer used primarily to promote vegetative growth and healthy green leaves.

DAP.purpose: Provides nitrogen and phosphorus to support early plant growth and root development.

14-35-14.purpose: Phosphorus-rich fertilizer generally used to support root development and flowering.

17-17-17.purpose: Balanced fertilizer supplying nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium for general crop nutrition.

20-20.purpose: Provides nitrogen and phosphorus to support crop growth and nutrient development.

28-28.purpose: High-analysis nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer used where both nutrients are needed.

10-26-26.purpose: Phosphorus- and potassium-rich fertilizer used to support roots, flowering, and overall crop development.
